title: AI for All: Operationalising Diversity and Inclusion Requirements for AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the inclusion of accessibility needs (e.g., visual, speech, and hearing impairments) in AI system requirements (user stories) generated by human experts versus GPT-4.

Comparing the inclusion of diverse racial and ethnic attributes (e.g., skin tone, African descent, specific ethnicities) in AI system requirements (user stories) generated by human experts versus GPT-4.
Comparing the inclusion of gender-diverse perspectives (e.g., females, transgender, and non-binary individuals) in AI system requirements (user stories) generated by human experts versus GPT-4.
Comparing the inclusion of religious sensitivities and attire (e.g., wearing a hijab or niqab) in AI system requirements (user stories) generated by human experts versus GPT-4.
Comparing the inclusion of age-related considerations (e.g., elderly users needing tailored onboarding, young users) in AI system requirements (user stories) generated by human experts versus GPT-4.

Comparing the inclusion of linguistic diversity (e.g., non-native English speakers, regional accents) in AI voice recognition system requirements (user stories) generated by human experts versus GPT-4.

Comparing the inclusion of physical appearance variations (e.g., wearing glasses, facial scars, recent facial surgery) in AI facial recognition system requirements (user stories) generated by human experts versus GPT-4.
